name: bazi-sazi
description: Bazi-Sazi — a web-native game engine studio: build, play, publish and share 2D/3D/VR multiplayer games in the browser.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,studio -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @bazi/server" "npm run dev -w @bazi/studio"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine --noEmit && tsc -p apps/studio --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit
